svg.title: Adaptive depth: a per-query margin instead of a fixed shortlist
svg.desc: Animated schematic of adaptive re-scoring depth. Two queries share one noise-based margin below their 10th code score. The crowded query has 59 candidates inside the margin, the well-separated one 18; a fixed shortlist of 30 would under-fetch for the first and over-fetch for the second.
svg.text: Adaptive depth: re-score every candidate within λσ of the 10th score
The code's score noise σ is calibrated once per collection, on self-queries.
The margin λσ is the same for every query; how many candidates fall inside it is not.
A fixed shortlist (dashed) over-fetches for one query and under-fetches for the other.
Crowded query: many candidates score close to the 10th
Well-separated query: the 10th stands clear of the rest
Schematic: synthetic code scores, one σ for both queries. Measured results: experiments/2026-11-hybrid-adaptive-matrix.
